audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers gave Poppy six of seven rows including 2+ items, against packet.levelChart (Skill/Poppy/Poppy/Skill/Skill/Skill/Wukong) and the whys, which say level 1 is weak for both, 4-5 flattens to even, first item stays even and he out-scales.
audit.why: The chart claimed Poppy wins the late game beside a why paragraph saying he out-scales her.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 3, 5 and 6 flipped as matched full+content pairs with ratings updated, and report[2] no longer says 'yours from level 1'.

audit.whatIsWrong: First-item and 2-item whys were boilerplate claiming Poppy's pattern is at full power.
audit.why: Iceborn Gauntlet lets her tank Crushing Blow's shred but he spikes in the same window; by two items his armour stacking beats her flat base damage.
audit.corrected: Both rows now name the actual reason.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer named no Wukong ability (packet defect) and the trade lines were generic 'his answer is down' placeholders. Crushing Blow's auto-attack reset was never given as the combo tell.
audit.why: Nimbus Strike is his only gap-close and Steadfast Presence grounds it, so W must be held for the dash, not spent on poke. Warrior Trickster's decoy is what eats a mistimed E or W. His combo opens on an auto reset, so the wind-up — not the cast — is the cue.
audit.corrected: Ability names and the auto-reset tell now stated across trades, dos and donts.

audit.why: The suspectName flag on 'Use Steadfast Presence' in the late paragraph is a false positive — Steadfast Presence is Poppy's own W, spelled correctly.

edits.before: Passive shield trades + Q zone control win early. Identify how Wukong contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Both of you are weak on one ability — last-hit, set up a wall angle, and do not burn E chasing him through the minions.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Nimbus Strike's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: It flattens out: your flat damage stops scaling while his keeps growing, so trade only when Nimbus Strike is spent and a wall is behind him.

edits.before: Iceborn Gauntlet is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Nimbus Strike's cooldown.
edits.after: Iceborn Gauntlet lets you tank his Crushing Blow shred, but he is spiking too — an even window.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Wukong carry threat 6/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: He out-scales: stacked armour and his item spike turn even trades against you. Trade W for his all-in and let your team handle him.

edits.before: Yours from level 1. See the level-by-level chart for the swing points.
edits.after: Yours at 2-3, even in the middle, his by two items. Plan recalls on that.

edits.before: E Wukong into a wall when his answer is down, Q the zone under him, and W any dash he tries — his mobility is a suggestion.
edits.after: E him into a wall the moment he commits Nimbus Strike, Q the zone under him, and hold W to ground the dash, never the poke.

edits.before: E-ing with no wall behind him — the wall-stun is the whole trade; the dash alone is a tickle.
edits.after: Spending E or W on Warrior Trickster's decoy — you are naked when the real one dives in.

edits.before: Dash engage — your W disables it! Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: It is his only gap-close and W grounds it — hold W until he commits.

edits.before: E Wukong into a wall when his answer is down, Q the zone under him, and W any dash he tries — his mobility is a suggestion.
edits.after: Crushing Blow opens on an auto-attack reset — the wind-up is your cue to step back, not the cast. Then ground Nimbus Strike with W.

edits.before: Wukong wastes Nimbus Strike — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Warrior Trickster leaves a decoy — never spend E or W on it.

edits.before: That is Wukong's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: The decoy exists to eat your E and W — step away and wait for the real Wukong.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Crushing Blow shreds your armour, so every auto after it hits harder.

edits.before: E-ing with no wall behind him — the wall-stun is the whole trade; the dash alone is a tickle.
edits.after: W spent on a poke trade leaves Nimbus Strike unanswered — hold it for the dash.

edits.before: Track Wukong's Nimbus Strike: Dash engage — your W disables it! When it is down — E-Q + R him.
edits.after: Nimbus Strike is his gap-close — W grounds it mid-dash, then E him into a wall and Q under him.
